outcome: anatomical dimensions of the vulva (e.g., length of glans of clitoris, labia minora width, length of introitus, perineal body length)
cohort: 400 adult Indian women aged 18 years and above.
finding: The study established mean vulval anatomical dimensions in adult Indian women and found statistically significant positive correlations of age, BMI, and obstetrical history with labia minora width.
cross-section timing: In adulthood (women aged 18 years and above)
